tiers.label: Caddie
tiers.perk: Helps cover simulation compute for the public arena benchmarks.

tiers.label: Birdie
tiers.perk: Helps fund agentic research runs: an agent proposes, trains and evaluates one idea.

tiers.label: Eagle
tiers.perk: Helps fund a full seat-cycled benchmark of a new agent, written up in the research notes.

projects.title: Autonomous research agent
projects.summary: An LLM agent that reads the research notes, proposes the next experiment, runs it with the existing training and seat-cycling scripts, and opens a pull request with its write-up.
projects.deliverable: A new note per run and a leaderboard entry for every agent it produces.

projects.title: Two-step Bayes lookahead
projects.summary: Extend the 1-step lookahead to reason about the next draw, and model opponents' likely end-of-hole timing.
projects.deliverable: A new L2 player and a seat-cycled comparison against L.

projects.title: LLM league
projects.summary: Run every major hosted model through the LLM harness for 100 matches each so the language-model rows on the leaderboard are statistically meaningful.
projects.deliverable: LLM leaderboard rows with 95% confidence intervals.

projects.title: Distill the lookahead into a DQN
projects.summary: Fine-tune the DQN champion to rank actions like the Bayes lookahead (Experiment 15).
